pairCheck.description: Read-only PNG RGB comparison outside approximate face rectangles. Values measure image differences, not geometric registration or motion acceptance.

deviations: Observed face centers are about 63.8% and 58.9%, rather than requested 68%.
Amara hair has only about 18 source pixels of headroom; 1.025 centered scaling leaves approximately 6 viewport pixels at 390x844.
Amara includes incidental book-spine lettering despite the no-text request.
Warm edits preserve the apparent camera/body/setting but are not pixel-identical outside the face.
acceptance: Source-art checkpoint only. Parent owns actual application integration, intermediate-frame verification and fresh independent review.
